name: Scotch Egg
body:
Station and Complexity friturier 6

Flavor Profiles umami, temperature, umami, salty, texture, temperature
Additional Ingredients salty, sour, spicy, or sweet

EFFECT

Duration 1 hour/level; Serving Size 6

DESCRIPTION

A Scotch egg is a boiled egg wrapped in sausage, coated in breadcrumbs and baked or deep-fried.

When consumed, it grants a morale bonus to AC equal to the culinarian’s Intelligence or Wisdom modifier for the duration (divided evenly between servings). If a creature that consumed the egg is wearing medium or heavy armor, or using a shield, the bonus is halved for that creature. These bonuses to AC apply even against touch attacks and when the creature is flat-footed. Creatures lose these bonuses when immobilized or helpless. These bonuses do not stack with the monk AC bonus or similar class features.

Additional ingredients grant an additional +1 bonus each. This bonus is not reduced by wearing armor or using a shield.
